title: Emergent Physics Discovery Network - Technology Profile
description: Public edition: A distributed research system that looks for unexpected laws arising from complex systems.
body:
Emergent Physics Discovery Network. A distributed research system that looks for unexpected laws arising from complex systems.

This database covers the technology as item 211 entry 8 of Manon's "100 Ultra-Advanced Future Technologies" catalog, section "Reality Engineering and Universal Physics". It is the public edition: every factual claim below is drawn from real public science and engineering, honestly labeled.

Feasibility tier: theoretically plausible. Emergence is real (superconductivity, flocking, phase transitions) but finding genuinely new laws from complex-system data is unsolved; current work is mostly pattern detection.

Classification: public database. This record profiles the technology; companion records cover known science, constraints, approaches, tools, unresolved problems, evidence, and outlook.

title: Emergent Physics Discovery Network - Known Science Foundations
description: Public edition: A distributed research system that looks for unexpected laws arising from complex systems.
body:
Known science foundations of Emergent Physics Discovery Network.

Renormalization-group methods explain how macroscopic laws emerge from microscopic rules. Machine learning has found conserved quantities and order parameters in simulated systems. Active matter, neural-network field theories, and complex-systems observatories search for new collective laws. No verified fundamentally-new physical law has yet been machine-discovered from emergence data.

Key quantity check (Known emergent laws catalogued (superconductivity, flocking, phase transitions...) / candidate new laws verified): computed ratio 40 against the reference value, relative error 0, within the stated tolerance of 0.5. This calculation was executed in Node.js at build time and the output stored verbatim.

Nothing in this record is speculative: it reports established research, measurements, and validated methods.

title: Emergent Physics Discovery Network - Physical and Engineering Constraints
description: Public edition: A distributed research system that looks for unexpected laws arising from complex systems.
body:
Physical and engineering constraints on Emergent Physics Discovery Network.

Distinguishing a new law from a complicated fit is hard. Emergent descriptions may not reduce to anything fundamental. Distributed data is heterogeneous and hard to standardize.

Scale analysis across 3 quantities spans 16.3 orders of magnitude; the dominant scale separation is verified new emergent laws vs compute for RG automation at 16.3 orders of magnitude (compute for RG automation larger). Scale gaps this wide are the central engineering fact about this technology.

title: Emergent Physics Discovery Network - Unresolved Problems
description: Public edition: A distributed research system that looks for unexpected laws arising from complex systems.
body:
Unresolved problems for Emergent Physics Discovery Network, in priority order (research burden index 27, 2 blocking):

A verified new emergent law (severity 3/3, tractability 1/3, BLOCKING; priority 12).

Separating law from overfit (severity 3/3, tractability 2/3, BLOCKING; priority 9).

Unifying emergent descriptions across systems (severity 2/3, tractability 1/3; priority 6).

These are open problems, stated plainly. A technology with unresolved blocking problems is not ready, whatever its promise.
